local function find_plugin(pattern)
  local list = ARDOUR.LuaAPI.list_plugins()
  for pi in list:iter() do
    local n = string.lower(pi.name or "")
    if string.find(n, string.lower(pattern), 1, true) then return pi end
  end
  return ARDOUR.PluginInfo()
end
local wanted = {"Dragonfly Hall", "LSP", "Black Pearl", "FluidSynth"}
local ok = 0
for _,pat in ipairs(wanted) do
  local pi = find_plugin(pat)
  if not pi:isnil() then
    local p = ARDOUR.LuaAPI.new_plugin(Session, pi.unique_id, pi._type, "")
    if not p:isnil() then
      print("GG_PLUGIN_INSTANCE=" .. pat .. "|" .. pi.name .. "|" .. pi.unique_id)
      ok = ok + 1
    end
  end
end
assert(ok >= 3, "fewer than three representative external plugins instantiated")
Session:save_state("")
print("GG_P2_PLUGIN_INSTANTIATION=PASS count=" .. tostring(ok))
